report.executive_summary: UK EV adoption is rising and public charging is expanding, but established networks already compete for sites and utilisation. A new charging company can find a niche, yet the opportunity is not an easy land-grab.

findings.claim: EV demand in the UK is still growing
findings.evidence: Official licensing statistics show battery-electric cars taking a larger share of new registrations.
Industry trackers show a large installed base of public charge points and several national operators.
findings.confidence_rationale: Industry data rather than audited filings
